messages:
auditor_jm: Hi team — quick Q ahead of tomorrow's SOC2 walkthrough. Can you confirm where we should pull the RBAC change history for the org-admin role (Aug–Nov last year), and whether KMS key rotation logs are bundled with the same export?

livia: Hey @auditor_jm — we have two sources: the auth service audit log (fast lookup) and the infra ACL change events in the platform audit bucket. RBAC git diffs live in infra-config repo but the authoritative is the auth service.

mike: For KMS rotation, key metadata + rotation events are in the key-manager service logs and also emitted to our central audit index. We can export them together.

anya: TL;DR: yes, we can produce a combined package (RBAC change list, signed policy snapshots, KMS rotation events, and the cross-linking evidence map). Need to know if you want CSV or the SOC2 'control evidence' layout.

auditor_jm: CSV is fine for the change timeline, but for KMS we need event payloads (who initiated, request_id, before/after key version, and HSM audit ref). Also chain-of-custody note for when keys left customer-managed HSM during the Private pilot.

livia: Noted. @mike can pull raw event payloads. We should include the playbook entry for emergency key rotation (it shows approval flow).

mike: Will do. Command I'll run: 
```
platformctl audit export --from 2023-08-01 --to 2023-11-30 --filters "event:rbac_change OR event:kms_rotation" --format ndjson --sign --output s3://redwood-compliance/packets/2023-q3q4-rbac-kms.ndjson
```
I'll attach the signed manifest after export.

sec-bot: Notice: export job queued (id=job-20261103-7f2). Estimated time 6m.

dan: For chain-of-custody on Private pilot, we have the deployment runbook entry and the sops metadata in the onprem-keystore repo. I'll pull the commit SHAs and link them.

rahul: FYI — there was a small vuln triage tied to the auth service in Oct where a mis-scoped migration briefly granted admin:list to a service account. We rotated creds and recorded remediation. Should I add that timeline to the package?

livia: Yes include the vuln triage note as supporting evidence for access control monitoring. Add the incident response ticket number and post-mortem link.

auditor_jm: Perfect — can you also surface any alerting/monitoring rules that would have detected an anomalous RBAC grant? Specifically: Kibana saved search name or SIEM rule id.

mike: SIEM rules: SIEM-AC-023 (unexpected role_grant), SIEM-KMS-009 (kms_rotation_without_approval). Saved search: "auth_service.role_changes_unexpected". I'll export rule configs.

anya: Packaging checklist I'm using: 1) RBAC timeline CSV (actor, target, before, after, request_id, ts) 2) KMS rotation ndjson raw events 3) Signed export manifest 4) Incident tickets + PM 5) Playbooks + runbook snippets 6) SIEM rule configs + detection screenshots 7) Mapping doc linking each item to SOC2 control IDs.

auditor_jm: Thanks — can you get the package to the shared compliance bucket by EOD PST? Also include md5 or sha256 checksums for each file.

livia: EOD PST is tight but achievable. @mike @dan — coordinate on the exports. I'll assemble the mapping doc.

mike: Export started: job-20261103-7f2 -> running. I'll attach checksums when done.

dan: Gathering runbook snippets now. Will push to s3://redwood-compliance/packets/2023-q3q4-rbac-kms/docs/ and ping when done.

sec-bot: Notice: job-20261103-7f2 completed (duration 4m12s). Objects: 3. Manifest signed by livia (sig=MEUCIQ...).

mike: Uploads complete. Files: 
- 2023-rbac-timeline.csv (sha256: a3f5...)
- 2023-kms-rotations.ndjson (sha256: b7c2...)
- siem-rules.json (sha256: c4d1...)

livia: Assembling final mapping doc now. Will include cross-refs to control IDs: CC6.1 / AC-L2 / KMS-A2 etc.

auditor_jm: Received notification and starting a quick pre-check. One follow-up: for the Oct vuln, who signed off the remediation? Need approver name and timestamp.

rahul: Approval by "anya" (timestamp 2023-10-18T14:03:22Z) — audit trail in the ticket (INC-2023-4127).

anya: Confirmed. I left an approval note and the PR link to the migration hotfix.

livia: Package uploaded here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-compliance/packets/2023-q3q4-rbac-kms/complete-package.zip (access: auditors@redwood.com). Manifest and checksums included.

auditor_jm: Great, I'll mark this as received. If I find gaps during the walkthrough I'll open a small follow-up thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mike: Thanks — standing by for any quick pulls.

livia: Closing the loop: post a note here if you need versions in a different format or additional logs (auth flow traces).

sec-bot: Reminder: retention policy for exported packets is 365 days.
